title: DSI-Bench: A Benchmark for Dynamic Spatial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the frequency of models selecting 'forward' options compared to the actual ground truth distribution, and using spatio-temporal flip augmentations (e.g., reversing video playback) to demonstrate the models' semantic prior and over-reliance on forward motion.

Applying spatial-temporal symmetry augmentations (horizontal flipping and time reversal) to benchmark videos and answer options to evaluate and mitigate models' inherent left/right or orientation-based spatial biases.
